obs._comment: main build ID (first 16 bytes of the module ID, 32 hex digits) -> rows {gate, offset, word, reason}; word = the 4 bytes at offset read as a little-endian u32. Offsets are the RVAs of dump.cs / script.json (main = RVA + 0x234000 in the DmIOS file).

aeea627ddbd1214764dfef5f965e94a2.reason: BattleDiceBehavior.UpdateDiceFinalValue epilogue (every path that stores _diceFinalResultValue at 0x244e980 reaches it, and so do the early exits): x19 = the BattleDiceBehavior

BattleDiceBehavior.GiveDamage, after TakeDamage and TakeBreakDamage have run and w25 (the damage actually taken) is stored by stp w25,w8,[x19,#84]: x19 = the BattleDiceBehavior, x27 = &card, x28 = &target (the closure's target field)
